$comment: Hash of each frozen version's slice in the dump it was blessed from, excluding doc/description/examples (none of which reach the generated output), taken off the parsed dump before generation runs (see lib/dump-digest.mts). Generation fails if a frozen version's slice moves, because its files are skipped and the rest of the tree would be generated against a model they no longer hold. Run `yarn generate:api` and paste what it prints to seed a version. Record $source when you do.
$source: TrueNAS 28.0.0-MASTER+20261123-045528 (a test appliance's own middlewared, `python3 -m middlewared.main --dump-api --keep-refs`, taken 2026-11-23), which carries middleware #20272 (an S3 grant's access may list its actions) and #20256 (SMB aapl_extensions, multichannel and streams removed). The 2026-11-19 seed's record still holds and is not repeated. The frozen files are not regenerated: no middleware commit since that dump touches api/v25_10_*, and what moved the 25.10 digests is the usual event-model leak -- the sharing.s3.query event's S3GrantEntry.access and SharingS3Entry.audit now carry master's action lists, and the sharing.smb.query event master's SMB entry. v25.10.1-.5 move only by inheritance. That SMB leak also renames: generation now calls 25.10's legacy options event arms SharingSmbLegacyOptInput and SharingSmbLegacyOptInput2 (the second without streams) and v27.0.0 imports them from the frozen v25_10_0, which declared only LegacyOptInput -- the gate's 'later versions may reference entries the frozen files lack', measured with the compiler. Both are hand-added to v25_10_0 as aliases of LegacyOptInput and re-exported by name from each patch index, as CoreGetJobsItemInput is, so v27.0.0's sharing.smb.query payload keeps streams (src/generated-hand-maintained.spec.ts). Two names leave the surface: v27_0_0.LegacyOptInput (its event arm is now SharingSmbLegacyOptInput2, same shape) and Access at v27.1.0 and v28.0.0, where a grant's access is now an inline union of the presets or an action list.
